newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa Afribrand details pre-listing share offer.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa Afribrand details pre-listing share offer.

text.p: South Africa's Afribrand Holdings Ltd on Tuesday announced details of its share offer ahead of its listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange on August 5.

The company has made a preferential offer of three million shares of one cent at an issue price of 100 cents per share and a public offer of 10 million of one cent each at an issue price of 100 cents per share.
Subject to obtaining a spread of shareholders acceptable to the JSE, the listing of 104.37 million Afrihold shares has been granted by the JSE in the "Food" sector.
